Why It’s Important To Have Your Mattress Cleaned

February 26, 2021

We all spend a great amount of time on our mattresses, but how much time do we spend cleaning our mattresses? The answer is probably no time at all! We use sheets and mattress toppers to protect the mattress, but these measures don’t fully protect our bed from dirt and bacterias that can thrive there. We spend about a third of our day on our mattress, so it is important that we take some care to maintain a clean and comfortable environment for the vital night’s rest we need. A mattress is one of the most important investments you can make in your life. Not only is it a major expense, it will also see more use than just about anything else you own. These days people are spending more time on their mattresses, as a comfortable spot to spend some hours working from home. So it is more important than ever that we take care of our mattress and have it cleaned by professionals who know how to do the job right.

Sheets Are Not Impenetrable

It may seem like our mattress stays clean, protected by layers of sheets and toppers, but there are tiny holes in these layers and dust and oils can still find their way to the mattress. Our bodies shed dead skin, hair and fluids in the night which will build up over time without a professional mattress cleaning service. The debris that builds up makes the perfect environment for dust mites, bacteria and fungus to live in and cause problems. When these elements are allowed to accumulate, they start to make odors and degrade the materials of the mattress.

Creepy Crawlers

Dust mites are tiny insects that can thrive in an uncleaned mattress, feeding on dead skin. Human beings shed about one and a half grams of skin a day, and this amount can possibly feed up to one million dust mites! These almost invisible bugs can cause allergic reactions and poop twice their body weight every day. If a mattress is not cleaned by a professional, they can fill a mattress with their excrement and ruin it. Allergic reactions to dust mites are no joke, but you may already be suffering and not realize it. Using professional mattress cleaningservices at least twice a year is the best way to ensure that dust mites do not completely take over your bed, affecting your health and degrading your mattress.

Steps For Mattress Cleaning

To start getting your mattress cleaning service, find out the mattress manufacturers instructions for cleaning. Some mattresses do not tolerate water cleaning, so it is important to figure out what sort of cleaning technique your mattress requires to make sure it lasts as long as possible. One method for mattress deep cleaning is mattress steam cleaning. This technique uses steam, the heat of which kills any dust mites, bacteria or fungi living in the mattress. After the mattress steam cleaning, a vacuum is used to suck any debris out of the mattress so that the mattress can start fresh again. A mattress that requires dry mattress cleaning is cleaned by a special process involving safe chemicals that will clean a sensitive mattress without damaging it with water. Dry mattress cleaning should only be attempted by a professional, as it is simply not practical for a homeowner to assemble the right tools and materials for the job.

Clean Routine

A good night’s sleep is the most important pillar of good health. Your mattress is the foundation for your restful sleep, so keeping it clean is a huge part of your health and wellness routine. Most people never clean their mattress, they think that it is protected by sheets and it seems too hard to clean the big heavy thing anyway. But this is a huge mistake that could lead to negative health effects and needing to change the mattress more often. If you have never cleaned your mattress, you should try pulling off the sheets and giving a close look at your bed. You will notice dust and stains that could easily be cleaned by a trusted professional. Imagine all the years of laying there and the mass of dead skin that has fallen and is feeding dust mites. Cleaning your mattress is a simple process for a professional, and should be a routine part of mattress maintenance. If you think about the cost of a new mattress, and figure that regular cleaning can add years or more to the life of your mattress, it is most likely saving you money to have the mattress cleaned instead of having to buy a new one. Plus the cleaning makes it almost like sleeping on a new mattress for the life of your bed, rather than potentially suffering through a dirty bed. Also, mattresses take up a lot of space at a landfill, and it is becoming a bigger and bigger problem. You can help this pollution problem by having your mattress cleaned and keeping it in your home for as long as possible.

Professional Mattress Cleaning

Your mattress is an integral but often neglected part of your home as well as a huge factor for your health and well-being. Without a proper mattress cleaning service, your sleep’s foundation can be undermined by your own dead skin and the dust mites that love to eat it. Luckily, there are many options for professional mattress cleaning services that can help you protect your mattress and give you peace of mind that your mattress is clean and supporting your vital sleep. Whether your mattress requires dry mattress cleaning or can tolerate a special mattress steam cleaning, the professionals can help you to extend the life of your mattress which could actually save you time and money. So, with all of this information, I suggest that you consider adding a mattress cleaning service to your home cleaning and maintenance routine. A mattress cleaning service will be a great investment in a good night’s sleep that you will surely benefit from in many ways.
